purpose: Provide a first-time public reviewer with a deterministic route through checked-in static artifacts before running any code or citing historical diagnostics as review context.

route.label: Open the checked-in artifact gallery
route.review_question: Can a first-time reviewer find the sample artifacts without running setup?
route.expected_public_signal: The first screen is a local static artifact, not a live service.

route.label: Read the sample Markdown report
route.review_question: Are metrics framed as historical diagnostics rather than forecasts?
route.expected_public_signal: The report describes a fixed historical sample and its assumptions.

route.label: Check the beginner reading boundary
route.review_question: Does the checklist keep predictions, recommendations, and advice out of scope?
route.expected_public_signal: A non-expert reader gets plain scope limits before citing or sharing the artifact.

route.label: Review the public evidence handoff
route.review_question: Does the handoff identify static files and deterministic verification commands?
route.expected_public_signal: The route can be checked from local files without private context.

route.label: Review the public rerun receipt
route.review_question: Can a reviewer see the exact public rerun commands and expected artifacts?
route.expected_public_signal: The receipt lists deterministic commands, PASS/WARN checks, and no-live-data/no-advice boundaries.

route.label: Inspect methodology and risk caveats
route.review_question: Are look-ahead, fees, overfitting, and leveraged ETF risks visible?
route.expected_public_signal: Known research limitations are documented next to the artifacts.

route.label: Finish with the reviewer acceptance scorecard
route.review_question: Does the final handoff summarize public-review readiness and remaining WARN items?
route.expected_public_signal: The scorecard closes the research-only handoff without approving trading use.

checklist.label: Static first screen is available
checklist.review_note: Start from reports/index.html and checked-in files only.

checklist.label: Route uses repo-relative public paths
checklist.review_note: Paths are stable repo artifacts and exclude machine-specific locations.

checklist.label: Non-advice boundary is explicit
checklist.review_note: Artifacts are historical research diagnostics, not recommendations or forecasts.

checklist.label: Deterministic verification commands are listed
checklist.review_note: Commands regenerate static review artifacts without live data or broker access.

checklist.label: Artifact byte hashes are recorded
checklist.review_note: Hashes identify local bytes at generation time, not financial correctness.

artifact_integrity_summary.scope: repo-relative checked-in static artifacts only; hashes confirm local file bytes at generation time, not financial correctness
